plugins.name: handoff-verifier
plugins.description: Self-verification hooks managed by MCP tools: a Stop reminder that forces one more reasoning turn before a turn ends, plus ExitPlanMode and AskUserQuestion gates that block the tool until you self-certify the constraints are met via a token confirm. Each check is set per global, project, or session scope, and the hook concatenates the active scopes broad-to-narrow

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Output styles and skills that control response prose: terse answers, ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, ADHD-shaped output, and removal of AI-sounding text

plugins.name: session-findings
plugins.description: Mine Claude Code session transcripts into self-contained per-session findings notes (bugs, development friction, reusable learnings) via a deterministic digest pass plus model classification; includes the digest/render scripts and a resumable sweep harness that writes findings.json and findings.md keyed by deterministic session id
